scope: Preserve declared location-scoped source references in the shared compatibility draft writer

behavior.source_reference_collection: Uses the agent's fixed public-view map and the caller-supplied source connection
behavior.signed_persistence: Includes collected references in the signed worker draft request
behavior.failure_behavior: Source-reference collection failure prevents draft persistence

limitations: This compatibility helper does not establish repeatable-read isolation; callers must use the canonical signed worker runner for a consistent synthesis/source snapshot.
The source connection's authentication and least-privilege boundary are not established by this helper.
Worker migrations and runtime credentials remain unrolled out; populated task parity and MAN-CAP-038 acceptance remain open.
